summary: ZyraV21 与 doublespending 提交 ERC-8065 扩展草案，用基于 ECDH 的隐身地址为零知识代币包装器提供隐私收款。thnhnv 提出 nonce 位图，让同一账户可并行提交多笔交易。nixorokish 公布 Hegotá 头号提案的选择时间表，FOCIL 是候选之一。

keywords_en: A stealth address extension for ERC-8065 zero knowledge token wrappers
a nonce bitmap for parallel transaction submission
CMSP a primitive for non-custodial recurring payments
summary_en: ZyraV21 and doublespending drafted an ERC-8065 extension that adds ECDH stealth addresses for private receiving to zero knowledge token wrappers. thnhnv proposed a nonce bitmap so one account can submit several transactions in parallel. nixorokish posted the Hegotá headliner timeline, with FOCIL among candidates.
